text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is here. With the Kikuka
Sho on the
horizon, this summer will put
us to the test.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The wheels of fortune go round and
round! All
aboard, we're heading
southward!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is finally here, Trainer.
Let's make it
one to remember!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And do know that our fate is at stake
here. If we
don't find ourselves in the
illumination of great
hope, only darkness
awaits. We either find
happiness or we
die!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: That's a bit of an exaggeration...

text_block_list.text:
M-maybe. But now you know how
determined I
really am.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Now then, according to my lucky map...
our
training camp is just up ahead.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Egads, the direction we're heading in
now is very
auspicious! Northeast, the
direction of the ox!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Let's keep on pushing! The farther we
go, the
more good fortune will come our
way!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Wait! We've gone past the central point
on my
map... That can only mean...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Ack?! We're going in the least
auspicious
direction possible! Bad luck is
upon us! STOP THE
BUS!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: They're not going to stop the bus...

text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I guess you're right... I just knew
this
summer wasn't going to be that
simple...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
But that's why I have to fight back with
everything
I've got. Come at me, endless
sea of challenges!
You'll have to get
through Trainer first!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
...I think I'll let her fend for herself. This
is bound
to be one fiery summer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
